name: Workspace Provisioner
description: Creates a project workspace, adds the requested members, then invites each person once.
expected_outcomes: Exactly one workspace with the requested name
One invitation per member, only after membership exists

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.contract: Stable operation_key deduplicates identical writes; a timeout does not establish whether a write committed.

tools.name: list_members
tools.contract: A read may be stale. Re-read to confirm missing members.

tools.name: send_invite
tools.contract: Stable operation_key deduplicates identical writes; invite only after membership exists.
